title: Importance Prioritized Policy Distillation

problem.claim: Existing policy distillation approaches assume that demonstration data in a decision-making sequence is uniformly distributed.

gap.claim: Uniform treatment of demonstration data may introduce unwanted bias because reinforcement learning maximizes reward rather than performing simple label matching.

contributions.claim: The work analyzes why and how frame importance matters in reinforcement learning settings.
The work proposes an importance-prioritized policy distillation framework that emphasizes training on important frames.
The framework measures frame importance using the reciprocal of weighted Shannon entropy from a teacher policy's action prescriptions.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Experiments on Atari games and policy compression tasks reportedly show that capturing frame importance significantly boosts the performance of distilled policies.

narrative_sequence.summary: Policy distillation is widely studied in deep reinforcement learning, but existing approaches assume uniformly distributed demonstration data.
Uniform treatment may cause unwanted bias because reinforcement learning is reward maximizing rather than simple label matching.
Adapting frame importance, defined by its contribution to expected reward on a frame, may improve the distilled student policy.
The authors analyze frame importance and propose a framework that prioritizes important frames, measuring importance with reciprocal weighted Shannon entropy from teacher action prescriptions.
Experiments on Atari games and policy compression tasks reportedly show improved distilled-policy performance when frame importance is captured.

source_observation.claim: Uniformly weighting demonstration data may introduce bias in reward-maximizing learning settings.

interpretation.claim: Training emphasis can be aligned with the contribution of individual observations to the task objective.

application.claim: For policy distillation, prioritize frames using a measure derived from the teacher policy's action prescriptions.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether the approach generalizes beyond the reported Atari games and policy compression tasks.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the Atari games, datasets, baselines, metrics, or numerical performance gains.
The abstract does not describe the analysis details or the training procedure beyond frame prioritization.
The abstract does not establish independent verification or reproducibility.
